headline: Popular Reports 26% Net Income Surge Driven by Strong Puerto Rico Labor Market
summary: Popular reported a 26% surge in third-quarter net income, citing economic strength and employment conditions in Puerto Rico.
why: Popular is the largest financial institution in Puerto Rico, serving as a primary barometer for the island's macroeconomic and financial health.

impacts.name: Popular, Inc.
impacts.why: Solid local employment boosted loan quality and consumer banking profitability.
